transcript: Yesterday, I saw Jonah at Roundabout, a new play by Rachel Bonds and I really enjoyed it. It's a four character play focused mostly on Ana in various bedrooms at a few different stages of her life. And although some of the subject matter is quite heavy, such as self harm and sexual trauma, there's definitely humor and the writing is fresh and conversational. Also, the way the story reveals itself is gradual and super engaging. An just an hour and 40 minutes, no scene is wasted and we get a gorgeously condensed portrait of Ana grappling with desire, intimacy, and trauma. Gabby Beans as Ana is fantastic in this — I really really enjoyed her performance. And on an unrelated note, shout out to whoever put together the absolutely fire pre-show playlist, I really enjoyed that too. With that, another playbill for my collection.
